infoPlist.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: midna sets the alarms you ask it for. They ring like the Clock app's, even in silent mode or a Focus.

plugins.faceIDPermission: midna asks for Face ID before you answer an approval.

plugins.photosPermission: midna sends the photos and videos you pick to your midna.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: midna uses where you are to help with what's around you. Your location goes only to your own midna, which keeps it as your history.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: With Always, your iPhone sends your precise location to your own midna as you move, even while the app is closed, and midna can ask where you are. It goes nowhere else.
